text:
incident-bot: ALERT fired - GPU memory pressure spike detected on pool 'gpool-gamma' (metric gpu_mem_util >= 92% for 3m). PagerDuty: PD-76321. Suspected source: high-concurrency inference jobs (kv-cache warmups). Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/infrarunbooks/gpu-mem-pressure

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-76321: Triggered at 2024-06-12T08:12:35Z -> paging eng-oncall rotation

Sam Lee: acked (oncall). I'm on it, taking lead. :hand:

Sam Lee: quick check — looking at pool-gamma telemetry. tail latency spike at the same window. Starting node-level checks.

Sam Lee: `ssh jump@gpool-gamma-node-03`
Sam Lee: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv -l 5`

Sam Lee: logs show repeated OOM messages from model-serving pods rw-infer-03/pm-embedder. Extract:
```
[2024-06-12T08:10:12Z] cuda: Cuda error: out of memory while allocating 1.2GiB (device 0)
[2024-06-12T08:10:12Z] model-serving: KV cache grow triggered, failed allocation -> worker restart
```

Maya Patel: saw same in metrics. KV cache warmups + a sudden burst of long context requests. Auto-batch config may have expanded beyond intended.

Chris Nguyen: adding logs from model-side:
```
E062 08:09:58 rw-infer-03 pm-embedder[pid: 2241] WARN cuda: attempted alloc 1280000000, avail 512MB
E062 08:10:10 rw-infer-03 pm-embedder[pid: 2241] INFO restarting worker due to OOM
```

Sam Lee: mitigation plan: 1) drain the busiest node(s) in pool-gamma, 2) apply temporary lower-kv-cache-size env override for affected model, 3) reroute a portion of traffic to gpool-beta. Doing 1) now.

infra-bot: automation: initiating progressive reroute from gpool-gamma -> gpool-beta at 20% traffic shift. See dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/pools/gpool-gamma

Maya Patel: cordoning node-03 and evicting pods now. Commands: 
```
kubectl cordon gpool-gamma-node-03
kubectl drain gpool-gamma-node-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

Maya Patel: eviction started. Expect ~90s for graceful shutdowns, some jobs may restart on other nodes.

Sam Lee: applying hotfix to the deployment to cap KV_CACHE_MAX_ITEMS=20000 on the rw-embedder service to avoid runaway growth. Patch command: 
```
kubectl set env deploy/rw-embedder KV_CACHE_MAX_ITEMS=20000 -n inference
```

Chris Nguyen: rolling restart of rw-embedder applied (maxUnavailable=1). Watching for fewer OOMs.

Sam Lee: customer impact note: internal sampling shows ~12% tail latency increase for customers using long-context chat (chat.acme, chat-beta). Error rate bump 502/503 ~1.9% window between 08:09-08:16 UTC. No major data loss; retries succeeded for most jobs.

Maya Patel: after cordon, node-03 shows memory released, but node-05 also starting to creep. Proceeding to cordon node-05 if reroute doesn't reduce pressure further.

infra-bot: reroute at 20% complete -> increasing to 40% by automation after 2 minutes if memory pressure persists.

Sam Lee: noticed one heavy client causing repeated long-context calls (api-key: acct-prod-1923). Reached out to SE team to throttle; SE responded and started temporary rate-limit rule on the API key.

ops-rotation: are we going to escalate PD -> SEV? Current impact limited to tail latency and small error bump. Recommend SEV-3 and postmortem.

Sam Lee: agree. Setting incident severity SEV-3 for now. No SLA breach yet but risk if pressure continues.

Maya Patel: reroute to 40% deployed by infra-bot. Observing memory util dip on gpool-gamma after KV cache cap and reroute. OOMs reduced to 0 in last 2 samples.

Chris Nguyen: confirming logs: no new cuda OOM entries for rw-embedder since 08:18 UTC. Sampled pod logs look healthy.

Sam Lee: I'll stay until stable for 30m. If anyone needs to take over, say now. Otherwise will handoff after stabilization window.

Maya Patel: I'll keep the cordon on node-03 for now and put a ticket to repro on staging with the same high-concurrency pattern.

Sam Lee: PagerDuty PD-76321 acknowledged by Sam Lee at 2024-06-12T08:13:00Z. Will mark resolved once we confirm 20m of no regressions and revert temporary KV cap policy if safe.

pagerduty-bot: PD-76321 status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

Maya Patel: summary for follow-up: action items: [1] create a safeguard throttle for long-context requests per API key (owner: SE); [2] evaluate default KV cache sizing and growth policy (owner: infra/serving); [3] add alert tuning to avoid paging for transient <5m spikes (owner: eng-sre).

Sam Lee: handing off active watch to Maya for the next 40m — I need to leave for another meeting. Maya, take PD oncall if further pages come.

Maya Patel: taking over watch and PD duty. acked. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: PD-76321: reassigned to Maya Patel at 2024-06-12T08:23:10Z.

Maya Patel: marking this thread for postmortem later. Will capture runbook improvements and root cause once we finish repro.

infra-bot: automation: reroute reduced to 10% after sustained improvement; all nodes memory under 70% utilization.

Maya Patel: closing PD once 20m stable. Will file follow-up ticket in infra backlog and ping product for customer communication if needed.

pagerduty-bot: PD-76321: resolved at 2024-06-12T08:55:33Z by Maya Patel.

Sam Lee: thanks all. Good coordination. We'll keep the temporary KV cap until patch is validated in staging.

Maya Patel: noted. Postmortem to follow.
